name: vertice
description: RPG multijugador persistente isométrico de ambientación cyberpunk (universo original: Ciudad Vértice)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: node tools/fetch-assets.mjs && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared --noEmit && tsc -p server --noEmit && tsc -p client --noEmit && tsc -p tools/loadtest --noEmit
